elements.name: Identity
elements.subtitle: What candidates see across the site.

elements.label: Accent Colour
elements.hint: Used for buttons, links and the progress ring

elements.name: Sittings
elements.subtitle: How the exam player behaves. These are read by the theme, not by core.

elements.label: Offer Practice Mode
elements.hint: Candidates start untimed and can move to Timed when ready. Switching to Timed clears their answers and restarts every clock, which the site warns them about first

elements.label: Allow Returning to Practice
elements.hint: Off by default, and deliberately. Going back to Practice after a timed sitting would let a candidate keep timed answers under an untimed label — the source system carried a flag permitting it that only changed the wording and cleared nothing

elements.label: Progress Save Interval (seconds)
elements.hint: How often the player reports time spent while a paper is open. Lower is more accurate after a browser crash and more chatty

elements.label: Require Every Case Answered Before Ending
elements.hint: On, a candidate cannot end a paper early with cases left blank. Off, they may end whenever they like — the timer still ends it for them in Timed mode either way

elements.name: Header Menu
elements.subtitle: The links in the site header. Leave the list empty and the theme falls back to a sensible default. Point them at pages you have actually created — nothing validates a URL here, and a wrong one is a 404 with nothing to explain it.

create.title: Add Link
create.subtitle: Where it goes, and what it says.

elements.label: URL
elements.hint: A path on this site, or a full address for somewhere else
